cls: Saline osmotic laxative (enema, bowel prep); buffer
pharm: Saline osmotic laxative (enema, bowel prep); buffer
summary: Dibasic sodium phosphate (with monobasic sodium phosphate) is used in phosphate enemas and oral bowel preparations. Oral phosphate preparations can cause acute phosphate nephropathy.
admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Osmotic water retention in the bowel lumen.

relative: Elderly, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, diuretics, NSAIDs (nephropathy risk)

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
monitoring: Electrolytes and renal function in at-risk patients
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
